# IMPERIA COLD WAR - COMECON 1970 (record of the Council: entries at vote close, RECORD tab, in force for the viewer).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_CMEA_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.

# Any scope, at the close of a vote (context of the file and its tally). Files it in the record; keeps the newest 24.
COLDWAR_CMEA_record_add = {
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_it value = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_res value = global.cwcm_ctx_res }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_day value = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_by value = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_tg value = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_iss value = global.cwcm_ctx_issue }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_nf value = global.cwcm_last_nf }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_nn value = global.cwcm_last_nn }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_na value = global.cwcm_last_na }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_rec_it^num > 24 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_it index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_res index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_by index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_tg index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_iss index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_nf index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_nn index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwcm_rec_na index = 0 }
	}
}

		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_d min = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_doy = cwcm_t_d }
		modulo_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_doy value = 365 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_y = cwcm_t_d }
		subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_y = cwcm_t_doy }
		divide_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_y = 365 }
		round_variable = cwcm_ui_rd_y
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_y = 1970 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 31 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 59 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 90 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -58 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 120 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 4 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -89 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 151 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -119 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 181 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 212 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 7 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -180 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 243 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 8 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -211 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 273 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 9 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -242 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 304 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 10 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -272 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 334 } }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 11 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -303 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_m = 12 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = cwcm_t_doy }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rd_d = -333 }
		}
	}
	# in force: in force for us
	clear_array = cwcm_ui_rf_all
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A1 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A2 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A3 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A4 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A5 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A6 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A7 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_A8 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B1 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 21 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B2 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 22 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B3 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 23 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B4 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 24 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B5 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B6 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 26 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C1 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 41 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C2 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 42 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C3 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 43 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C4 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 44 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C5 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C6 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 46 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C7 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 47 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D1 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 61 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D2 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 62 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D3 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 63 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D4 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 64 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D5 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 65 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_D6 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 66 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M1 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 141 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M2 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 142 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M3 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 143 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M4 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 144 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M5 }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_ui_rf_all = 145 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf = cwcm_ui_rf_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = cwcm_ui_nrf }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 6 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 7 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpages = cwcm_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpage < cwcm_ui_rfpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpage = cwcm_ui_rfpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_ui_rfpage min = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpage1 = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_rfpage1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf6 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf7 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf1 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf2 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf3 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf4 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf5 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 5 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf6 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = cwcm_ui_rfpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_i = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_nrf > cwcm_t_i } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ui_rf7 = cwcm_ui_rf_all^cwcm_t_i }
	}
}
